vibe_rationale: Ten editions in, a small, adults-only, scene-led psytrance and techno camping festival; close to the community and curation traits but a single scene.
fit_notes: 21+ camping crowd, a clean adult audience for a health brand, and a small scale that keeps cost low. No sponsors or partnership contact are visible, so partner policy is unknown; a recovery, hydration or rest-space role would need to be pitched directly to the organiser.
